description:
Reuse a lesson solved in another repository before rebuilding a shared pattern. Unlike engram_recall or engram_smarter, this explicitly excludes target_repo from source searches and adds transfer lessons and quality gates. Returns Markdown with ranked memories and source repos from other authenticated workspace repositories, with optional public knowledge.

source_repos restricts the search; include_public supplements sparse private results. Records retrieval telemetry without copying knowledge. Consumes workspace daily call quota. OAuth: memory:read.

context.description: Natural-language task and relevant facts, e.g. migrate our PostgreSQL schema with zero downtime. Never include credentials or raw customer data.

depth.description: Default focused uses a small retrieval budget; deep expands it when focused results are insufficient. An explicit limit overrides the default budget.

include_public.description: Default true: supplement private results with public knowledge when needed. False searches only other private workspace repositories.

limit.description: Maximum retrieved memories, 1–25. Omitted defaults: focused=5, deep=12; explicit values override these defaults.

session_id.description: Exact journal id from start/rehydrate/list_sessions. Disambiguates parallel work; writing requires your active session. Rehydrate may read shared or closed history.

source_repos.description: Restrict source repositories to these slugs; omit or pass an empty array to search other repositories.

items.description: Source repository slug in this workspace.

target_repo.description: Destination repository slug for the current work; memories from this repo are excluded from the source search.

name: engram_cross_pollinate

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: Cross-Pollinate Knowledge
